describe('#879 — armourDefencePenalty behaviour (D1 + D2)', () => {
  it('returns 0 when no worn armour is present', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    const c = mkChar({ equipment: [] });
    expect(mod.armourDefencePenalty(c)).toBe(0);
  });

  it('returns 0 for armour items in non-worn states', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    const items = [
      { _id: 'aaa1', bucket: 'combat_gear', armour_value: 1, defence_penalty: 2 },
      { _id: 'aaa2', bucket: 'combat_gear', armour_value: 1, defence_penalty: 3 },
    ];
    const c = mkChar({ equipment: [
      { catalogue_id: 'aaa1', state: 'carried' },
      { catalogue_id: 'aaa2', state: 'stashed' },
    ]});
    expect(mod.armourDefencePenalty(c, mkLookup(items))).toBe(0);
  });

  it('D1: filters by bucket === \'combat_gear\' with isCombatGearArmourShaped(entry) — ignores worn non-combat_gear-shaped items', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    const items = [
      // A weapon-shaped item with NO armour fields populated at all (the
      // realistic "genuinely not armour" case - a real weapon never carries
      // a defence_penalty). Combining weapon_type AND defence_penalty on one
      // fixture, as an earlier version of this test did, is not a realistic
      // data shape and is no longer how this predicate is proven correct.
      { _id: 'wep1', bucket: 'combat_gear', weapon_type: 'melee', damage_mod: 2, armour_value: null, defence_penalty: null },
      { _id: 'arm1', bucket: 'combat_gear', armour_value: 1, defence_penalty: 2 },
    ];
    const c = mkChar({ equipment: [
      { catalogue_id: 'wep1', state: 'worn' },
      { catalogue_id: 'arm1', state: 'worn' },
    ]});
    expect(mod.armourDefencePenalty(c, mkLookup(items))).toBe(2);
  });

  it('EQC-1 review patch (#1152, Codex external review HIGH finding): a legacy-migrated armour item with armour_value: null but defence_penalty populated still counts (single-field check was wrong)', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    // Under the OLD (pre-EQC-1) schema, bucket-specific fields were
    // independently nullable - a real legacy armour item could have set only
    // defence_penalty and left armour_value unset. After migration to
    // combat_gear, this item must STILL be recognised as armour-shaped.
    const items = [{ _id: 'legacy-arm', bucket: 'combat_gear', armour_value: null, defence_penalty: 2 }];
    const c = mkChar({ equipment: [{ catalogue_id: 'legacy-arm', state: 'worn' }] });
    expect(mod.armourDefencePenalty(c, mkLookup(items))).toBe(2);
  });

  it('EQC-1 review patch (#1152): a legacy-migrated weapon with weapon_type: null but damage_mod populated is still weapon-shaped (isCombatGearWeaponShaped)', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    expect(mod.isCombatGearWeaponShaped({ bucket: 'combat_gear', weapon_type: null, damage_mod: 2 })).toBe(true);
    expect(mod.isCombatGearWeaponShaped({ bucket: 'combat_gear', weapon_type: null, damage_type: 'lethal' })).toBe(true);
    expect(mod.isCombatGearWeaponShaped({ bucket: 'combat_gear', weapon_type: null, damage_mod: null, damage_type: null })).toBe(false);
    expect(mod.isCombatGearWeaponShaped(null)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('EQC-1 review patch (#1152): isCombatGearArmourShaped mirrors the same OR-of-fields shape', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    expect(mod.isCombatGearArmourShaped({ armour_value: null, defence_penalty: 1 })).toBe(true);
    expect(mod.isCombatGearArmourShaped({ armour_value: 1, defence_penalty: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(mod.isCombatGearArmourShaped({ armour_value: null, defence_penalty: null })).toBe(false);
    expect(mod.isCombatGearArmourShaped(null)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('EQC-1 (#1152): a non-combat_gear bucket is ignored even with armour_value populated', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    const items = [
      { _id: 'x1', bucket: 'narrative', armour_value: 3, defence_penalty: 9 },
    ];
    const c = mkChar({ equipment: [{ catalogue_id: 'x1', state: 'worn' }] });
    expect(mod.armourDefencePenalty(c, mkLookup(items))).toBe(0);
  });

  it('D2: returns the MAX defence_penalty across multiple worn armour items (worst-case stacking)', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    const items = [
      { _id: 'arm1', bucket: 'combat_gear', armour_value: 1, defence_penalty: 1 },
      { _id: 'arm2', bucket: 'combat_gear', armour_value: 1, defence_penalty: 3 },
      { _id: 'arm3', bucket: 'combat_gear', armour_value: 1, defence_penalty: 2 },
    ];
    const c = mkChar({ equipment: [
      { catalogue_id: 'arm1', state: 'worn' },
      { catalogue_id: 'arm2', state: 'worn' },
      { catalogue_id: 'arm3', state: 'worn' },
    ]});
    expect(mod.armourDefencePenalty(c, mkLookup(items))).toBe(3);
  });

  it('treats null/undefined/non-integer defence_penalty as 0', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    const items = [
      { _id: 'a1', bucket: 'combat_gear', armour_value: 1, defence_penalty: null },
      { _id: 'a2', bucket: 'combat_gear', armour_value: 1, defence_penalty: undefined },
      { _id: 'a3', bucket: 'combat_gear', armour_value: 1, defence_penalty: 'bad' },
    ];
    const c = mkChar({ equipment: items.map(it => ({ catalogue_id: it._id, state: 'worn' })) });
    expect(mod.armourDefencePenalty(c, mkLookup(items))).toBe(0);
  });

  it('ignores items with no catalogue match (fail-soft per Concern #5)', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    const c = mkChar({ equipment: [{ catalogue_id: 'ghost', state: 'worn' }] });
    expect(mod.armourDefencePenalty(c, () => undefined)).toBe(0);
  });
});

describe('#879 — materialiseDerivedDefence (D3 + D4)', () => {
  it('writes c.derived.defence = max(0, calcDefence - armourDefencePenalty), floors at 0', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    const accessors = await import('../../public/js/data/accessors.js');
    // calcDefence on the mkChar fixture: min(Dex=3, Wits=3) + Athletics=2 + discBonus=0 = 5.
    const c = mkChar({ equipment: [{ catalogue_id: 'arm1', state: 'worn' }] });
    const items = [{ _id: 'arm1', bucket: 'combat_gear', armour_value: 1, defence_penalty: 2 }];
    const result = mod.materialiseDerivedDefence(c, mkLookup(items));
    expect(result).toBe(accessors.calcDefence(c) - 2);
    expect(c.derived.defence).toBe(result);
  });

  it('D2-FLOOR: clamps to 0 when armourPenalty exceeds base defence', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    // Tiny char: Dex=1, Wits=1, Athletics=0 → calcDefence = 1.
    const tinyChar = mkChar({
      attributes: { ...mkChar().attributes, Dexterity: { dots: 1, bonus: 0 }, Wits: { dots: 1, bonus: 0 } },
      skills: {},
      equipment: [{ catalogue_id: 'arm1', state: 'worn' }],
    });
    const items = [{ _id: 'arm1', bucket: 'combat_gear', armour_value: 1, defence_penalty: 5 }];
    expect(mod.materialiseDerivedDefence(tinyChar, mkLookup(items))).toBe(0);
  });
});

describe('#879 — defenceForDisplay (read-site helper)', () => {
  it('returns materialised c.derived.defence when present', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    const c = mkChar({ derived: { defence: 42 } });
    expect(mod.defenceForDisplay(c)).toBe(42);
  });

  it('Concern #4 verbatim: STM mod on derived.defence is visibly reflected (modded > base)', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    const accessors = await import('../../public/js/data/accessors.js');
    // Materialise then simulate applyStMods writing the modded value to c.derived.defence.
    const c = mkChar({ equipment: [] });
    mod.materialiseDerivedDefence(c);
    const base = accessors.calcDefence(c);
    expect(c.derived.defence).toBe(base);
    // Simulate STM mod: +3
    c.derived.defence = base + 3;
    expect(mod.defenceForDisplay(c)).toBe(base + 3);
  });

  it('Concern #4 verbatim: STM mod can push displayed defence below 0 per ADR-004 no-bounds (single-floor invariant Concern #9)', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    // Pre-condition: c.derived.defence = 1 (post-materialisation, no overlay).
    // STM mod = -5 → c.derived.defence = -4.
    const c = mkChar({ derived: { defence: -4 } });
    // defenceForDisplay reads the materialised value verbatim — no defensive
    // clamp. The renderer displays -4. (Concern #9: floor lives only at
    // materialiseDerivedDefence, NOT here.)
    expect(mod.defenceForDisplay(c)).toBe(-4);
  });
});

describe('#879 — defenceMechanicalBase (export-site helper)', () => {
  it('always computes fresh — ignores c.derived.defence (which may carry overlay)', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    const accessors = await import('../../public/js/data/accessors.js');
    // Even if c.derived.defence is overlay-modded to some weird value,
    // defenceMechanicalBase returns the canonical mechanical baseline.
    const c = mkChar({
      equipment: [{ catalogue_id: 'arm1', state: 'worn' }],
      derived: { defence: 99 },   // overlay-modded; should be ignored
    });
    const items = [{ _id: 'arm1', bucket: 'combat_gear', armour_value: 1, defence_penalty: 2 }];
    const result = mod.defenceMechanicalBase(c, mkLookup(items));
    expect(result).toBe(Math.max(0, accessors.calcDefence(c) - 2));
    expect(result).not.toBe(99);
  });
});

describe('#1153 EQC-2 — isEquipmentOnMe (on-me vs owned-elsewhere)', () => {
  it('true for carried, worn, active', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    expect(mod.isEquipmentOnMe({ state: 'carried' })).toBe(true);
    expect(mod.isEquipmentOnMe({ state: 'worn' })).toBe(true);
    expect(mod.isEquipmentOnMe({ state: 'active' })).toBe(true);
  });

  it('false for stashed and lost', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    expect(mod.isEquipmentOnMe({ state: 'stashed' })).toBe(false);
    expect(mod.isEquipmentOnMe({ state: 'lost' })).toBe(false);
  });

  it('false for a null/undefined item, never throws', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    expect(mod.isEquipmentOnMe(null)).toBe(false);
    expect(mod.isEquipmentOnMe(undefined)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('AC #4: "on me" (carried) is independent of "bonus currently active" (worn) for armour — a carried-but-unworn item is on you but grants no AR', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    const items = [{ _id: 'arm1', bucket: 'combat_gear', armour_value: 1, defence_penalty: 3 }];
    const c = mkChar({ equipment: [{ catalogue_id: 'arm1', state: 'carried' }] });
    // On you (carried counts for isEquipmentOnMe)...
    expect(mod.isEquipmentOnMe(c.equipment[0])).toBe(true);
    // ...but armourDefencePenalty's own worn-only gating is completely
    // unaffected by this story — a carried-not-worn breastplate grants 0 AR.
    expect(mod.armourDefencePenalty(c, mkLookup(items))).toBe(0);
  });
});

    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');

    expect(mod.equipmentContainerLabel(item, allEquipment, lookup)).toBe('(in: Test Haven)');
  });

  it('AC #4: returns null (renders as loose) when the referenced container is no longer owned — a dangling container_id after the container row was removed', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };

    const item = { catalogue_id: 'knife1', container_id: 'haven1' };

    // was removed) — only the contained item itself remains.
    const allEquipment = [item];
    const lookup = id => (id === 'haven1' ? haven : undefined);
    expect(mod.equipmentContainerLabel(item, allEquipment, lookup)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('returns null when the container_id is genuinely unresolvable in the catalogue too (belt-and-braces)', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');

    const allEquipment = [item, { catalogue_id: 'ghost1', state: 'active' }];
    const lookup = () => undefined;
    expect(mod.equipmentContainerLabel(item, allEquipment, lookup)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('does not match against itself — an item is never its own container', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    const item = { catalogue_id: 'x1', container_id: 'x1' };
    const lookup = () => ({ name: 'Should not resolve' });
    expect(mod.equipmentContainerLabel(item, [item], lookup)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('returns the parenthesised "(in: X)" form per AC #4\'s literal text', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    const haven = { name: 'Test Haven' };
    const item = { catalogue_id: 'knife1', container_id: 'haven1' };
    const allEquipment = [item, { catalogue_id: 'haven1' }];
    expect(mod.equipmentContainerLabel(item, allEquipment, () => haven)).toBe('(in: Test Haven)');
  });
});

===== server/tests/issue-871-876-ecm-4-9-bundle.test.js =====
/**
 * Issue #871 (ECM-4) + #876 (ECM-9) — DT form catalogue dropdown bundle.
 *
 * Two slices:
 *   1. ECM-4: equipment section is un-hidden; downtime-form.js no longer
 *      writes free-text `equipment_${n}_name`; the catalogue dropdown
 *      sources from the shared cache module ECM-5 introduced; app.js
 *      boot-loads the cache + wires onCatalogueUpdate; admin DT view
 *      falls back to legacy free-text for in-flight submissions per
 *      Khepri's backcompat guidance.
 *   2. ECM-9: item_request textarea is rendered on the DT form and
 *      surfaced as a labelled block on the admin processing UI; schema
 *      documents the field.
 *
 * Static-analysis throughout — no browser harness in this repo. Manual
 * UI smoke is captured in the PR test plan.
 */

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const REPO_ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..');
function read(rel) { return fs.readFileSync(path.join(REPO_ROOT, rel), 'utf8'); }

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// ECM-4
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe('#871 — equipment section is un-hidden', () => {
  it('downtime-data.js declares hidden: false on the equipment section', () => {
    const src = read('public/js/tabs/downtime-data.js');
    // Find the equipment-section block and confirm hidden: false.
    const idx = src.indexOf("key: 'equipment'");
    expect(idx).toBeGreaterThan(-1);
    const block = src.slice(idx, idx + 600);
    expect(block).toMatch(/hidden:\s*false/);
    expect(block).not.toMatch(/hidden:\s*true/);
  });
});

describe('#871 — downtime-form.js wires the catalogue dropdown', () => {
  const src = read('public/js/tabs/downtime-form.js');

  it('imports getCatalogue + getCatalogueEntry from the shared cache module', () => {
    expect(src).toMatch(/import\s+\{\s*getCatalogue,\s*getCatalogueEntry\s*\}\s+from\s+['"]\.\.\/data\/equipment-catalogue-cache\.js['"]/);
  });

  it('renderEquipmentRow no longer renders a free-text name input', () => {
    // The legacy line was: `<input type="text" id="dt-equipment_${n}_name" ...>`.
    // It must be gone.
    expect(src).not.toMatch(/<input[^>]*id="dt-equipment_\$\{n\}_name"/);
  });

  it('renderEquipmentRow renders a select with id `dt-equipment_${n}_catalogue_id`', () => {
    expect(src).toMatch(/<select id="dt-equipment_\$\{n\}_catalogue_id"/);
  });

  it('emits optgroups per bucket (combat_gear / skill_gear / tool_utility / narrative / container — EQC-1 #1152)', () => {
    // The render iterates the new five-value taxonomy and emits <optgroup label="...">
    expect(src).toMatch(/for\s*\(\s*const\s+bucket\s+of\s+\[\s*['"]combat_gear['"]\s*,\s*['"]skill_gear['"]\s*,\s*['"]tool_utility['"]\s*,\s*['"]narrative['"]\s*,\s*['"]container['"]\s*\]/);

  285: // #896 — Equipment availability filter + Fixer errata (Peter 2026-06-18).
  286: //
  287: // Composition is simple subtraction with no overlay/scene-state interaction
  288: // (per Khepri dispatch — no ADR needed). The helpers below are pure: take
  289: // (item, c) → number / boolean. Read sites use them at render time; DT form
  290: // uses them to gate dropdown affordability.
  291: //
  292: // Fixer errata: the 2-dot Social merit Fixer reduces the availability cost
  293: // of all items by 1. Applies in all usage and displays — dropdown, sheet
  294: // held-items, admin editor row labels (the admin editor BYPASSES the
  295: // affordability gate but still SHOWS the reduced number for consistency).
  296: //
  297: // Out of scope (Peter / Khepri): admin catalogue page (ECM-6) shows raw
  298: // catalogue availability; it is character-agnostic.
  299: // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  300: 
  301: /**
  302:  * Resources cap = effective rating of the character's Resources merit, or 0
  303:  * if absent. Uses meritEffectiveRating so cp / xp / free / bonus channels
  304:  * compose correctly without re-walking the merit array.
  305:  *
  306:  * @param {object} c - character document
  307:  * @returns {number} resources rating (0-5)
  308:  */
  309: export function availabilityCap(c) {
  310:   if (!c) return 0;
  311:   const m = (c.merits || []).find(x => x?.name === 'Resources');
  312:   return m ? meritEffectiveRating(c, m) : 0;
  313: }
  314: 
  315: /**
  316:  * Fixer reduction = 1 if the character has Fixer merit with effective rating
  317:  * >= 1, else 0. The Fixer merit is a fixed 2-dot Social merit per the rules,
  318:  * but we gate on the effective-rating check rather than mere presence so a
  319:  * suppressed / zeroed Fixer entry (edge case during merit editing) doesn't
  320:  * spuriously grant the reduction.
  321:  *
  322:  * @param {object} c - character document
  323:  * @returns {0 | 1} reduction magnitude
  324:  */
  325: export function fixerReduction(c) {
  326:   if (!c) return 0;
  327:   const m = (c.merits || []).find(x => x?.name === 'Fixer');
  328:   if (!m) return 0;
  329:   return meritEffectiveRating(c, m) >= 1 ? 1 : 0;
  330: }
  331: 
  332: /**
  333:  * Effective availability of a catalogue item for a specific character:
  334:  *
  335:  *   effectiveAvailability(item, c) = max(0, item.availability - fixerReduction(c))
  336:  *
  337:  * Floored at 0 so a level-0 item with Fixer doesn't surface as -1; the
  338:  * floor lives here, no clamp needed at consumer sites (same single-floor
  339:  * discipline as ADR-006 Concern #9).
  340:  *
  341:  * `item` may be a catalogue entry (post-ECM-1 shape with `availability` int
  342:  * field) OR a partial; null/undefined item or missing availability defaults
  343:  * to 0.
  344:  *
  345:  * @param {object} item - catalogue entry
  346:  * @param {object} c - character document
  347:  * @returns {number} effective availability (0-5)
  348:  */
  349: export function effectiveAvailability(item, c) {
  350:   const raw = Number.isInteger(item?.availability) ? item.availability : 0;
  351:   return Math.max(0, raw - fixerReduction(c));
  352: }
  353: 
  354: /**
  355:  * Convenience wrapper: is the item within the character's affordability gate?
  356:  *
  357:  *   isAffordable(item, c) = effectiveAvailability(item, c) <= availabilityCap(c)
  358:  *
  359:  * Used by the DT form dropdown to disable unaffordable options. The admin
  360:  * character editor explicitly BYPASSES this gate (ST override) but still
  361:  * displays the effective availability per Peter's dispatch.
  362:  *
  363:  * @param {object} item - catalogue entry
  364:  * @param {object} c - character document
  365:  * @returns {boolean}
  366:  */
  367: export function isAffordable(item, c) {
  368:   return effectiveAvailability(item, c) <= availabilityCap(c);
  369: }

  371: // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  372: // EQC-4 (issue #1155, epic #1038) — stat-tweak request. "Tweakable" is the
  373: // bucket's ONE primary numeric bonus field, per Angelus's scope ruling: the
  374: // combat_gear weapon/armour split reuses isCombatGearWeaponShaped /
  375: // isCombatGearArmourShaped above (same single-source-of-truth discipline as
  376: // every other EQC story) rather than re-deriving the shape check a third
  377: // time. tool_utility/narrative/container have no numeric bonus field by
  378: // design and are never tweakable.
  379: // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  381: /**
  382:  * Which stat field a catalogue entry's one-step "+1" tweak request applies
  383:  * to, or null if the entry has no tweakable numeric bonus at all.
  384:  *
  385:  * @param {object} entry - catalogue entry
  386:  * @returns {'damage_mod'|'armour_value'|'bonus_dice'|null}
  387:  */
  388: export function equipmentTweakableField(entry) {
  389:   if (!entry) return null;
  390:   if (entry.bucket === 'combat_gear') {
  391:     if (isCombatGearWeaponShaped(entry)) return 'damage_mod';
  392:     if (isCombatGearArmourShaped(entry)) return 'armour_value';
  393:     return null;
  394:   }
  395:   if (entry.bucket === 'skill_gear') return 'bonus_dice';
  396:   return null;
  397: }

 5535: // Legacy-compat: in-flight DT submissions from before this cycle carry
 5536: // `equipment_${n}_name` as a free-text string with no `_catalogue_id`.
 5537: // Per Khepri's dispatch + epic backcompat, we render those as a disabled

 5540: // uncommitted and the legacy name survives until the player edits).
 5541: function renderEquipmentRow(n, saved) {
 5542:   const items = getCatalogue();
 5543:   const byBucket = new Map();
 5544:   for (const it of items) {
 5545:     if (!byBucket.has(it.bucket)) byBucket.set(it.bucket, []);
 5546:     byBucket.get(it.bucket).push(it);
 5547:   }
 5548:   for (const arr of byBucket.values()) {
 5549:     arr.sort((a, b) => (a.name || '').localeCompare(b.name || ''));
 5550:   }
 5551: 
 5552:   const selectedId = saved[`equipment_${n}_catalogue_id`] || '';
 5553:   const legacyName = saved[`equipment_${n}_name`] || '';
 5554: 
 5555:   // #896: per-character affordability gate. Resources rating is the cap
 5556:   // for effective availability (raw - fixer reduction). The raw-availability
 5557:   // max a character can afford is `cap + fixer` — that's the number we
 5558:   // show in the tooltip + footnote (matches the dispatch's wording).
 5559:   const cap   = availabilityCap(currentChar);
 5560:   const fixer = fixerReduction(currentChar);
 5561:   const rawMax = cap + fixer;
 5562: 
 5563:   let h = `<div class="dt-equipment-row" id="dt-equipment-row-${n}">`;
 5564:   h += `<div class="dt-equipment-row-fields">`;
 5565:   h += `<select id="dt-equipment_${n}_catalogue_id" class="qf-input dt-equip-cat">`;
 5566:   h += `<option value="">\u2014 select item \u2014</option>`;
 5567:   if (legacyName && !selectedId) {
 5568:     h += `<option value="" disabled>(legacy: ${esc(legacyName)} \u2014 please reselect)</option>`;
 5569:   }
 5570:   // EQC-1 (#1152, epic #1038, 2026-08-13): re-partitioned from the old four
 5571:   // buckets (weapon/armour/equipment/asset) to five; labels use
 5572:   // EQUIPMENT_BUCKET_LABELS rather than the bare bucket value (combat_gear/
 5573:   // skill_gear/tool_utility need real spacing, not a raw enum string).
 5574:   const EQUIPMENT_BUCKET_LABELS = {
 5575:     combat_gear: 'Combat Gear', skill_gear: 'Skill Gear', tool_utility: 'Tools / Utility',
 5576:     narrative: 'Narrative', container: 'Container',
 5577:   };
 5578:   for (const bucket of ['combat_gear', 'skill_gear', 'tool_utility', 'narrative', 'container']) {
 5579:     const arr = byBucket.get(bucket);
 5580:     if (!arr || !arr.length) continue;
 5581:     h += `<optgroup label="${esc(EQUIPMENT_BUCKET_LABELS[bucket] || bucket)}">`;
 5582:     for (const it of arr) {
 5583:       const sel       = String(it._id) === selectedId ? ' selected' : '';
 5584:       const eff       = effectiveAvailability(it, currentChar);
 5585:       const aff       = isAffordable(it, currentChar);
 5586:       const disabled  = (!aff && !sel) ? ' disabled' : '';
 5587:       const tooltip   = !aff
 5588:         ? ` title="Above your effective availability (Resources ${cap} + Fixer ${fixer} = max ${rawMax}). Use the item request field below to ask the ST for it."`
 5589:         : '';
 5590:       const availTag  = (it.availability == null) ? '' : ` (avail ${eff})`;
 5591:       h += `<option value="${esc(String(it._id))}"${sel}${disabled}${tooltip}>${esc(it.name || '')}${availTag}</option>`;
 5592:     }
 5593:     h += `</optgroup>`;
 5594:   }
 5595:   h += `</select>`;
 5596:   // #896: footnote under the dropdown \u2014 surfaces the cap math so players
 5597:   // see why some options are disabled without hovering each.
 5598:   h += `<div class="dt-equipment-cap-note" style="font-size:0.8em;opacity:0.7;margin-top:2px;">Showing items you can acquire. Resources ${cap} + Fixer reduction ${fixer} = effective availability cap ${rawMax}.</div>`;
 5599:   h += `<input type="number" id="dt-equipment_${n}_qty" class="qf-input dt-equip-qty" placeholder="Qty" min="1" value="${esc(saved[`equipment_${n}_qty`] || '1')}">`;
 5600:   h += `<input type="text" id="dt-equipment_${n}_notes" class="qf-input dt-equip-notes" placeholder="Notes (optional)" value="${esc(saved[`equipment_${n}_notes`] || '')}">`;
 5601:   if (n > 1) h += `<button type="button" class="dt-sorcery-remove" data-remove-equipment="${n}" title="Remove">\u00D7</button>`;
 5602:   h += '</div>';
 5603:   // EQC-4 (#1155, epic #1038 item 5): "+1 tweak" request \u2014 one dot of
 5604:   // availability per shift, capped to the bucket's ONE primary numeric
 5605:   // bonus field (see equipmentTweakableField). Only shown once a tweakable
 5606:   // item is selected; the request is captured here for the ST to adjudicate
 5607:   // (grant via a distinct catalogue entry) - no automated granting happens
 5608:   // in this form.
 5609:   const selectedEntry = selectedId ? getCatalogueEntry(selectedId) : null;
 5610:   const tweakField = selectedEntry ? equipmentTweakableField(selectedEntry) : null;
 5611:   if (tweakField) {
 5612:     const tweakCost = tweakedAvailability(selectedEntry);
 5613:     const tweakChecked = saved[`equipment_${n}_tweak`] === 'true' ? ' checked' : '';
 5614:     const overCap = tweakCost > rawMax;
 5615:     const warning = overCap

 5617:       : '';
 5618:     h += `<div class="dt-equipment-tweak" style="margin-top:4px;">`;
 5619:     h += `<label><input type="checkbox" id="dt-equipment_${n}_tweak" class="dt-equip-tweak"${tweakChecked}> Request +1 ${esc(tweakField)} (raises cost to avail ${tweakCost})</label>`;
 5620:     h += warning;
 5621:     h += `</div>`;
 5622:   }
 5623:   h += '</div>';
 5624:   return h;
 5625: }

  116:   let equipmentUsed = 0;
  117:   for (let n = 1; n <= t.equipmentSlots; n++) {
  118:     if (_nonEmpty(r[`equipment_${n}_catalogue_id`]) || _nonEmpty(r[`equipment_${n}_name`])) equipmentUsed++;
  119:   }
  120: 
  121:   return {
  122:     personal_actions:  { used: projectsUsed,     total: t.projectSlots     },
  123:     sphere_actions:    { used: spheresUsed,      total: t.sphereSlots      },
  124:     status_actions:    { used: statusUsed,       total: t.statusSlots      },
  125:     contact_actions:   { used: contactsUsed,     total: t.contactSlots     },
  126:     retainer_actions:  { used: retainersUsed,    total: t.retainerSlots    },
  127:     mentor_actions:    { used: mentorsUsed,      total: t.mentorSlots      },
  128:     staff_actions:     { used: staffUsed,        total: t.staffSlots       },
  129:     acquisition_slots: { used: acquisitionsUsed, total: t.acquisitionSlots },
  130:     sorcery_slots:     { used: sorceriesUsed,    total: t.sorcerySlots     },
  131:     equipment_slots:   { used: equipmentUsed,    total: t.equipmentSlots   },
  132:     xp_spend_slots:    { used: xpSpendUsed,      total: t.projectSlots     },
  133:   };
  134: }

  138:  * skipping categories with total === 0 so the modal isn't padded with
  139:  * irrelevant rows for characters who have no contacts merits, etc.

    1: /**
    2:  * DT submission MINIMAL-completeness check (ADR-003 §Q3, §Q8).
    3:  *
    4:  * Single source of truth for "is this player above the minimum-complete bar
    5:  * this cycle?". Lives in its own module so it can be imported client-side
    6:  * (downtime-form lifecycle) and, in a future Q7 server-side validation pass,
    7:  * by the API without dragging form code along.
    8:  *
    9:  * Pure ESM. No DOM. No `document` / `window` / `localStorage` / `fetch`.
   10:  *
   11:  * MINIMAL set per ADR §Q2:
   12:  *   court + personal_story (reduced) + feeding (simplified)
   13:  *   + 1 project + regency-if-regent
   14:  *
   15:  * Each rule below mirrors the §Q8 spec and is inverted to drive the
   16:  * banner's missing-pieces list (story #17 UI affordance #1).
   17:  */
   18: 
   19: // dt-form.20 fix-up (Ma'at PR #98 review, bug 1): MINIMAL has no pool builder,
   20: // so `_feed_disc` / `_feed_custom_*` stay empty when a player only fills the
   21: // 5-field simplified form. The method-card pick still persists `_feed_method`,
   22: // so include it as a method-set signal. Without this, hard-mirror per #17
   23: // never unlocks for MINIMAL users — banner sticks even with all 5 fields set.
   24: const FEEDING_POOL_KEYS = ['_feed_method', '_feed_disc', '_feed_custom_attr', '_feed_custom_skill', '_feed_custom_disc'];
   25: 
   26: function isNonEmptyString(v) {
   27:   return typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length > 0;
   28: }
   29: 
   30: function _hasAnyGameRecount(responses) {
   31:   // Any of game_recount_1..5 non-empty, or the legacy joined `game_recount`.
   32:   for (let n = 1; n <= 5; n++) {
   33:     if (isNonEmptyString(responses[`game_recount_${n}`])) return true;
   34:   }
   35:   return isNonEmptyString(responses.game_recount);
   36: }
   37: 
   38: // Issue #939: Personal Story (Off-Screen Life) is now OPTIONAL. It was
   39: // previously gated by a _hasPersonalStory() check here; that helper and its
   40: // callers (isMinimalComplete + missingMinimumPieces) were removed so a blank
   41: // Personal Story no longer holds a player's downtime XP credit.
   42: 
   43: function _hasFeedingTerritory(responses) {
   44:   // feeding_territories is a JSON-stringified map of slug → state. Any slug
   45:   // not 'none' counts as a chosen feeding territory.
   46:   let grid;
   47:   try { grid = JSON.parse(responses.feeding_territories || '{}'); } catch { return false; }
   48:   if (!grid || typeof grid !== 'object') return false;
   49:   return Object.values(grid).some(state => isNonEmptyString(state) && state !== 'none');
   50: }
   51: 
   52: function _hasFeedingMethod(responses) {
   53:   return FEEDING_POOL_KEYS.some(k => isNonEmptyString(responses[k]));
   54: }
   55: 
   56: function _hasFeedingBloodType(responses) {
   57:   let arr;
   58:   try { arr = JSON.parse(responses._feed_blood_types || '[]'); } catch { return false; }
   59:   return Array.isArray(arr) && arr.length > 0;
   60: }
   61: 
   62: function _hasFeedingViolence(responses) {
   63:   return isNonEmptyString(responses.feed_violence);
   64: }
   65: 
   66: function _hasFeedingComplete(responses) {
   67:   // dt-form.22: ROTE in a project slot does NOT satisfy the feeding rule.
   68:   // Primary feeding (territory + method + blood type + violence) must be
   69:   // filled independently. ROTE is captured under the `1 project slot`
   70:   // MINIMAL rule (any non-empty `project_1_action`, including 'rote').
   71:   return _hasFeedingTerritory(responses)
   72:       && _hasFeedingMethod(responses)
   73:       && _hasFeedingBloodType(responses)
   74:       && _hasFeedingViolence(responses);
   75: }
   76: 
   77: function _hasFirstProject(responses) {
   78:   return isNonEmptyString(responses.project_1_action);
   79: }
   80: 
   81: /**
   82:  * @param {object} responses           — submission.responses bag
   83:  * @param {object} [ctx]               — optional caller-side context
   84:  * @param {boolean} [ctx.isRegent]      — true if the character owns a regent territory
   85:  * @param {boolean} [ctx.regencyConfirmed] — true if the regent has confirmed feeding rights this cycle
   86:  * @param {boolean} [ctx.attended]      — true if the character attended last game; defaults true so callers without attendance context are unaffected
   87:  * @returns {boolean}
   88:  */
   89: export function isMinimalComplete(responses, ctx = {}) {
   90:   if (!responses || typeof responses !== 'object') return false;
   91:   const { isRegent = false, regencyConfirmed = false, attended = true } = ctx;
   92: 
   93:   if (attended && !_hasAnyGameRecount(responses)) return false;
   94:   // Issue #939: Personal Story no longer gates minimum-complete (optional).
   95:   if (!_hasFeedingComplete(responses)) return false;
   96:   if (!_hasFirstProject(responses)) return false;
   97:   if (isRegent && !regencyConfirmed) return false;
   98:   return true;
   99: }
  100: 
  101: /**
  102:  * Inverts isMinimalComplete to drive the banner's missing-pieces list.
  103:  *
  104:  * @param {object} responses
  105:  * @param {object} [ctx]
  106:  * @returns {{section: string, label: string}[]}
  107:  */
  108: export function missingMinimumPieces(responses, ctx = {}) {
  109:   const out = [];
  110:   if (!responses || typeof responses !== 'object') {
  111:     out.push({ section: 'court', label: 'Fill in your game recount' });
  112:     out.push({ section: 'feeding', label: 'Pick a feeding territory, method, blood type, and Kiss/Violent toggle' });
  113:     out.push({ section: 'projects', label: 'Pick an action for Project 1' });
  114:     return out;
  115:   }
  116:   const { isRegent = false, regencyConfirmed = false, attended = true } = ctx;
  117: 
  118:   if (attended && !_hasAnyGameRecount(responses)) {
  119:     out.push({ section: 'court', label: 'Game Recount: add at least one highlight from last session' });
  120:   }
  121:   // Issue #939: Personal Story is optional — not listed as a missing piece.
  122:   if (!_hasFeedingTerritory(responses)) {
  123:     out.push({ section: 'feeding', label: 'Feeding: pick a territory to hunt in' });
  124:   }
  125:   if (!_hasFeedingMethod(responses)) {
  126:     out.push({ section: 'feeding', label: 'Feeding: pick a method (build the hunt pool)' });
  127:   }
  128:   if (!_hasFeedingBloodType(responses)) {
  129:     out.push({ section: 'feeding', label: 'Feeding: pick at least one blood type' });
  130:   }
  131:   if (!_hasFeedingViolence(responses)) {
  132:     out.push({ section: 'feeding', label: 'Feeding: choose Kiss or Violent' });
  133:   }
  134:   if (!_hasFirstProject(responses)) {
  135:     out.push({ section: 'projects', label: 'Project 1: pick an action' });
  136:   }
  137:   if (isRegent && !regencyConfirmed) {
  138:     out.push({ section: 'regency', label: 'Regency: confirm this cycle’s feeding rights' });
  139:   }
  140:   return out;
  141: }

   15:  *
   16:  * EQC-1 (issue #1152, epic #1038) — bucket re-partition, 2026-08-13. The old

   18:  *
   19:  *   combat_gear  — weapons AND armour, distinguished by which stat fields are
   20:  *                  populated (damage_mod/damage_type/weapon_type = weapon-shaped;
   21:  *                  armour_value/defence_penalty = armour-shaped). Both sets of
   22:  *                  fields stay on the schema for this bucket; a given item
   23:  *                  populates whichever subset applies and leaves the rest null.
   24:  *   skill_gear   — old `equipment` bucket, unchanged meaning (skill_domain +
   25:  *                  bonus_dice). Renamed only.
   26:  *   tool_utility — NEW. "Does a thing, no bonus" per the epic description —
   27:  *                  mechanical_effect (free text), no numeric bonus field.
   28:  *   narrative    — NEW. Purely descriptive; no bucket-specific stat fields.
   29:  *   container    — old `asset` bucket. "Assets are containers... no
   30:  *                  stat-stacking on the asset itself" (epic #1038) — holds
   31:  *                  other equipment (see character.schema.js's `container_id`)
   32:  *                  rather than granting a bonus of its own. mechanical_effect
   33:  *                  stays available for descriptive/narrative notes (e.g. what
   34:  *                  a haven confers), not a combat bonus.
   35:  *
   36:  * Migration: server/scripts/migrate-eqc1-bucket-taxonomy.mjs maps every live
   37:  * equipment_catalogue document from the old enum to the new one
   38:  * (weapon→combat_gear, armour→combat_gear, equipment→skill_gear,
   39:  * asset→container). Must run before/alongside this schema landing — see that
   40:  * script's own header for why the two cannot ship independently.

  287: function renderBucketFields(bucket, initial) {
  288:   const fields = BUCKET_FIELDS[bucket] || [];
  289:   if (!fields.length) return '';
  290:   const labels = {
  291:     damage_mod: 'Damage mod',
  292:     damage_type: 'Damage type (lethal / bashing)',
  293:     weapon_type: 'Weapon type',
  294:     armour_value: 'Armour value',
  295:     defence_penalty: 'Defence penalty',
  296:     skill_domain: 'Skill domain',
  297:     bonus_dice: 'Bonus dice',
  298:     mechanical_effect: 'Mechanical effect',
  299:   };
  300:   const numericFields = new Set(['damage_mod', 'armour_value', 'defence_penalty', 'bonus_dice']);
  301:   const longFields = new Set(['mechanical_effect']);
  302:   return `<fieldset class="ec-bucket-fieldset"><legend>${bucket}-specific</legend>${
  303:     fields.map(f => {
  304:       const val = initial[f];
  305:       const type = numericFields.has(f) ? 'number' : 'text';
  306:       const inputHtml = longFields.has(f)
  307:         ? `<textarea id="ec-f-${f}" rows="2">${esc(val ?? '')}</textarea>`
  308:         : `<input id="ec-f-${f}" type="${type}" value="${esc(val ?? '')}">`;
  309:       return `<div class="ec-form-field"><label>${labels[f] || f}</label>${inputHtml}</div>`;
  310:     }).join('')
  311:   }</fieldset>`;
  312: }

  329: /**
  330:  * Read current form values. `coerce=true` casts numeric fields to numbers /
  331:  * null for the API. `coerce=false` (used by bucket-switch re-render) keeps
  332:  * raw strings so the form preserves user input across renders.
  333:  */
  334: function collectFormValues(coerce = true) {
  335:   const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
  336:   const bucket = $('ec-f-bucket')?.value || (_editingId ? (_items.find(it => String(it._id) === String(_editingId))?.bucket) : 'skill_gear');
  337:   const name = ($('ec-f-name')?.value || '').trim();
  338:   const description = ($('ec-f-description')?.value || '').trim() || null;
  339:   const availRaw = $('ec-f-availability')?.value;
  340:   const availability = availRaw === '' || availRaw === undefined ? null : Number(availRaw);
  341:   const tagsRaw = $('ec-f-tags')?.value || '';
  342:   const tags = tagsRaw.split(',').map(t => t.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  343: 
  344:   const out = { bucket, name, description, availability, tags };
  345: 
  346:   const fields = BUCKET_FIELDS[bucket] || [];
  347:   const numericFields = new Set(['damage_mod', 'armour_value', 'defence_penalty', 'bonus_dice']);
  348:   for (const f of fields) {
  349:     const raw = $(`ec-f-${f}`)?.value;
  350:     if (raw === undefined) continue;
  351:     if (!coerce) { out[f] = raw; continue; }
  352:     if (raw === '' || raw === null) { out[f] = null; continue; }
  353:     out[f] = numericFields.has(f) ? Number(raw) : raw;
  354:   }
  355:   return out;
  356: }

  365: async function onSave(initial) {
  366:   const values = collectFormValues(true);
  367:   if (!values.name) { showFormMsg('Name is required.', 'error'); return; }
  368:   if (!values.bucket) { showFormMsg('Bucket is required.', 'error'); return; }
  369: 
  370:   if (!_editingId) {
    1: /**
    2:  * Equipment catalogue cache (Epic ECM, ECM-5 / issue #872).
    3:  *
    4:  * Module-level cache fed by `GET /api/equipment_catalogue` at boot. Consumers
    5:  * (currently `editor/edit.js` per ECM-5; `editor/sheet.js` and `suite/roll.js`
    6:  * fold in alongside the static-module deletion in ECM-7) read from the cache
    7:  * rather than the static `EQUIPMENT_CATALOGUE` import. Refetches on receipt
    8:  * of a `broadcastCatalogueUpdate` WS frame so admin catalogue edits propagate
    9:  * to every open dropdown without a page reload.
   10:  *
   11:  * Lookup keys (post-ECM-3 canonical shape):
   12:  *   - `_id` is an ObjectId on disk; the JSON-serialized 24-hex string is what
   13:  *     the cache stores and what consumers reference (matches the wire format
   14:  *     of `character.equipment[].catalogue_id`).
   15:  *   - `getCatalogueEntry` accepts either the 24-hex `_id` string (canonical)
   16:  *     or the legacy `id` slug (returns the matching doc if either is found —
   17:  *     legacy fallback retained until ECM-7 deletes the static module).
   18:  */
   19: 
   20: import { apiGet } from './api.js';
   21: 
   22: let _items = [];
   23: let _byId = new Map();
   24: let _byBucket = new Map();
   25: let _loaded = false;
   26: let _inFlight = null;
   27: const _onChangeListeners = new Set();
   28: 
   29: function _index(items) {
   30:   _items = items.slice();
   31:   _byId = new Map();
   32:   _byBucket = new Map();
   33:   for (const it of _items) {
   34:     const id = String(it._id);
   35:     _byId.set(id, it);
   36:     if (!_byBucket.has(it.bucket)) _byBucket.set(it.bucket, []);
   37:     _byBucket.get(it.bucket).push(it);
   38:   }
   39:   // Stable alphabetical order within each bucket for the dropdown UX.
   40:   for (const arr of _byBucket.values()) {
   41:     arr.sort((a, b) => (a.name || '').localeCompare(b.name || ''));
   42:   }
   43:   _loaded = true;
   44: }
   45: 
   46: /**
   47:  * Fetch the catalogue from the API and populate the cache. Idempotent —
   48:  * concurrent callers share the same in-flight promise. After load, every
   49:  * registered `onCatalogueChange` listener fires.
   50:  */
   51: export async function loadCatalogue() {
   52:   if (_inFlight) return _inFlight;
   53:   _inFlight = (async () => {
   54:     try {
   55:       const items = await apiGet('/api/equipment_catalogue');
   56:       _index(Array.isArray(items) ? items : []);
   57:     } catch (err) {
   58:       console.error('[equipment-catalogue-cache] load failed:', err);
   59:       _index([]);   // empty cache rather than throw — consumers degrade to no-options
   60:     } finally {
   61:       _inFlight = null;
   62:     }
   63:     for (const fn of _onChangeListeners) {
   64:       try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.error('[equipment-catalogue-cache] listener err:', e); }
   65:     }
   66:   })();
   67:   return _inFlight;
   68: }
   69: 
   70: export function isLoaded() { return _loaded; }
   71: 
   72: export function getCatalogue() { return _items.slice(); }
   73: 
   74: export function getCatalogueByBucket(bucket) {
   75:   return (_byBucket.get(bucket) || []).slice();
   76: }
   77: 
   78: export function getCatalogueEntry(idOrSlug) {
   79:   if (idOrSlug == null) return null;
   80:   const key = String(idOrSlug);
   81:   const byId = _byId.get(key);
   82:   if (byId) return byId;
   83:   // Legacy fallback — slug field on items from the pre-ECM-3 era. Should be
   84:   // absent on post-ECM-2 docs; ECM-7 removes the static module + this branch.
   85:   return _items.find(it => it.id === idOrSlug) || null;
   86: }
   87: 
   88: /**
   89:  * Register a listener that fires after every successful cache reload.
   90:  * Returns an unsubscribe function. Used by edit.js to re-render the
   91:  * dropdown when a remote catalogue edit lands via WS.
   92:  */
   93: export function onCatalogueChange(fn) {
   94:   _onChangeListeners.add(fn);
   95:   return () => _onChangeListeners.delete(fn);
   96: }
   97: 
   98: /**
   99:  * Force a refetch. Wired to the `broadcastCatalogueUpdate` WS frame in
  100:  * `public/js/data/ws.js`. Cheap because the catalogue is small (~70 docs
  101:  * pre-ECM-9; an item-request flow may push that higher but stays bounded).
  102:  */
  103: export async function refetchCatalogue() {
  104:   _inFlight = null;
  105:   return loadCatalogue();
  106: }

import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const REPO_ROOT = path.resolve(__dirname, '..', '..');
function read(rel) { return fs.readFileSync(path.join(REPO_ROOT, rel), 'utf8'); }

// Convenience character builders for the behavioural slice.
function mkChar({ resources = 0, fixer = false } = {}) {
  const merits = [];
  if (resources > 0) merits.push({ name: 'Resources', category: 'general', cp: resources });
  if (fixer)         merits.push({ name: 'Fixer',     category: 'general', cp: 2 });
  return {
    name: 'Fixture', merits,
    attributes: {}, skills: {}, disciplines: {}, equipment: [],
  };
}

function mkItem(availability) {
  return { _id: 'item-' + availability, bucket: 'equipment', name: 'Item ' + availability, availability };
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe('#896 — availabilityCap', () => {
  it('returns 0 when the character has no Resources merit', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    expect(mod.availabilityCap(mkChar())).toBe(0);
  });

  it('returns the Resources rating when present', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    expect(mod.availabilityCap(mkChar({ resources: 3 }))).toBe(3);
  });

  it('handles null character defensively', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    expect(mod.availabilityCap(null)).toBe(0);
  });
});

describe('#896 — fixerReduction', () => {
  it('returns 0 when the character has no Fixer merit', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    expect(mod.fixerReduction(mkChar())).toBe(0);
  });

  it('returns 1 when Fixer is present', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    expect(mod.fixerReduction(mkChar({ fixer: true }))).toBe(1);
  });

  it('returns 0 when Fixer entry is present but zeroed (edge case during merit editing)', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    const c = mkChar();
    c.merits.push({ name: 'Fixer', category: 'general', cp: 0, xp: 0, free: 0 });
    expect(mod.fixerReduction(c)).toBe(0);
  });
});

describe('#896 — effectiveAvailability', () => {
  it('returns raw item.availability when Fixer is absent', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    expect(mod.effectiveAvailability(mkItem(3), mkChar())).toBe(3);
  });

  it('returns (raw - 1) when Fixer is present', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    expect(mod.effectiveAvailability(mkItem(3), mkChar({ fixer: true }))).toBe(2);
  });

  it('floors at 0 — a level-0 item with Fixer does NOT surface as -1', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    expect(mod.effectiveAvailability(mkItem(0), mkChar({ fixer: true }))).toBe(0);
  });

  it('treats null/undefined/non-integer availability as 0', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    expect(mod.effectiveAvailability({ availability: null }, mkChar())).toBe(0);
    expect(mod.effectiveAvailability({ availability: undefined }, mkChar())).toBe(0);
    expect(mod.effectiveAvailability({ availability: 'bad' }, mkChar())).toBe(0);
    expect(mod.effectiveAvailability(null, mkChar())).toBe(0);
  });
});

describe('#896 — isAffordable', () => {
  it('exactly at cap is affordable (<=, not strict less-than)', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    // Resources 2, raw availability 2 → effective = 2, cap = 2 → affordable.
    expect(mod.isAffordable(mkItem(2), mkChar({ resources: 2 }))).toBe(true);
  });

  it('above cap is unaffordable', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    expect(mod.isAffordable(mkItem(3), mkChar({ resources: 2 }))).toBe(false);
  });

  it('Fixer lifts an out-of-reach item into affordability', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    // Resources 2: raw availability 3 → effective = 3, cap = 2 → unaffordable.
    expect(mod.isAffordable(mkItem(3), mkChar({ resources: 2 }))).toBe(false);
    // Resources 2 + Fixer: raw 3 → effective = 2, cap = 2 → affordable.
    expect(mod.isAffordable(mkItem(3), mkChar({ resources: 2, fixer: true }))).toBe(true);
  });

  it('Resources 0 + Fixer still affords availability-1 items (the documented edge case)', async () => {
    if (typeof globalThis.location === 'undefined') globalThis.location = { hostname: '' };
    const mod = await import('../../public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js');
    // No Resources, Fixer present: raw 1 → effective = 0, cap = 0 → affordable.
    expect(mod.isAffordable(mkItem(1), mkChar({ fixer: true }))).toBe(true);
    // Same character can't afford raw 2 (effective 1, cap 0 → false).
    expect(mod.isAffordable(mkItem(2), mkChar({ fixer: true }))).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('#896 — DT form dropdown wires affordability gate', () => {
  const src = read('public/js/tabs/downtime-form.js');

  it('imports availabilityCap / fixerReduction / effectiveAvailability / isAffordable from the helper module', () => {
    expect(src).toMatch(/import\s+\{\s*availabilityCap,\s*fixerReduction,\s*effectiveAvailability,\s*isAffordable\s*\}\s+from\s+['"]\.\.\/data\/equipment-derivation\.js['"]/);
  });

  it('renders unaffordable options as <option disabled> with the dispatch tooltip copy verbatim', () => {
    // Tooltip wording: 'Above your effective availability (Resources ${cap} + Fixer ${fixer} = max ${rawMax}). Use the item request field below to ask the ST for it.'
    expect(src).toMatch(/Above your effective availability \(Resources \$\{cap\} \+ Fixer \$\{fixer\} = max \$\{rawMax\}\)\. Use the item request field below to ask the ST for it\./);
  });

  it('appends `(avail X)` to each option label using the effective number', () => {
    expect(src).toMatch(/const\s+eff\s*=\s*effectiveAvailability\(it,\s*currentChar\)/);
    expect(src).toMatch(/\(avail \$\{eff\}\)/);
  });

  it('renders the footnote with cap + fixer math', () => {
    expect(src).toMatch(/Showing items you can acquire\. Resources \$\{cap\} \+ Fixer reduction \$\{fixer\} = effective availability cap \$\{rawMax\}\./);
  });

  it('does NOT hide unaffordable items — they remain visible but disabled (per dispatch UX)', () => {
    // The optgroup loop iterates EVERY item, then chooses disabled vs enabled.
    // If items were hidden, the dispatch's "all options visible" guarantee would break.
    const fnStart = src.indexOf('function renderEquipmentRow');
    const fnEnd   = src.indexOf('\n}\n', fnStart);
    const body    = src.slice(fnStart, fnEnd);
    expect(body).not.toMatch(/if\s*\(\s*!aff\s*\)\s*continue/);
  });

  it('exempts the currently-selected option from being disabled (so existing in-flight selections remain visible)', () => {
    // The conditional `(!aff && !sel)` means a currently-selected unaffordable
    // item still renders enabled — silent-leave per the same backcompat
    // discipline as ECM-4's legacy-name fallback.
    expect(src).toMatch(/\(!aff\s*&&\s*!sel\)\s*\?/);
  });
});

   17: availability dot for it,
   18: **so that** minor customisation ("this pistol, but +1 damage") is a structured, capped request the ST

   49: ## Explicitly NOT this story

   51: - **No new schema field.** No stat-override on `character.equipment[]` rows. See Architecture decision.
   52: - **No automated granting.** An ST still manually creates the tweaked catalogue variant and assigns it
   53:   via existing tooling (equipment-catalogue-admin.js CRUD + the equipment-add flow from EQC-1/EQC-3).
   54:   This story only structures the REQUEST.
   55: - **No downward tweaks.** The mechanic is "pay more, get a better stat" (anti micro-sword cheese is
   56:   about capping UPGRADES, not modelling downgrades nobody would rationally request). Always +1 to the
   57:   bucket's primary numeric stat, never −1.
   58: - **No stacking multiple tweaks on one item, and no tweaking `tool_utility`/`narrative`/`container`
   59:   items** — they have no primary numeric bonus field to tweak in the first place.
   60: - **No change to the existing affordability-gate dropdown logic for CHOOSING which items appear** —
   61:   that's #896's own established behaviour, untouched. This story adds a tweak checkbox that appears
   62:   AFTER an item is chosen, not a new filtering dimension on the dropdown itself.
   63:

   68:    `'bonus_dice'` for a `skill_gear` entry, `null` otherwise (including a combat_gear entry that's

   70: 2. `equipment-derivation.js` exports `tweakedAvailability(entry)`: returns `(entry.availability ?? 0)
   71:    + 1` when `equipmentTweakableField(entry)` is non-null, `null` when it's not tweakable at all (there
   72:    is no meaningful "tweaked cost" for an item with no tweakable stat).
   73: 3. `tabs/downtime-form.js`'s equipment acquisition row (`renderEquipmentRow`) shows a "+1 tweak"
   74:    checkbox once an item is selected, ONLY when that item is tweakable, labelled with which stat and
   75:    the resulting availability cost (e.g. "+1 damage_mod (raises cost to avail 3)"). Unchecked by
   76:    default; state persists via a new `equipment_${n}_tweak` response key (boolean-as-string, matching
   77:    the existing `qty`/`notes` field convention).
   78: 4. The row re-renders when the catalogue-item dropdown changes (new delegated-change-handler branch,
   79:    matching the existing pattern for Carthian Pull / rote dropdowns in the same file), so the tweak
   80:    checkbox's visibility tracks the CURRENTLY selected item, not a stale one.
   81: 5. When the tweak checkbox is checked and the tweaked cost (`tweakedAvailability`) exceeds the
   82:    character's effective availability cap, the row shows a warning matching the existing
   83:    over-cap-tooltip wording style (`isAffordable`-based) — informational only, does not block saving
   84:    the draft (STs adjudicate DT submissions, same as every other field in this form).
   85: 6. `npm test`: every equipment-related suite green; no new failures.
   86: 7. TM Wiki, TM Cockpit, and TM Herald are completely untouched — TM Suite-only.

+# Pass 2 — Edge Case Hunter (frozen before reading the story)
+
+## High
+
+### [Pass 2] The captured tweak request is invisible in the ST processing UI
+
+- **Severity:** High
+- **File:line:** `public/js/admin/downtime-views.js:1647`
+- **Triggering input or sequence:** A player selects a tweakable catalogue item, checks `equipment_1_tweak`, and lets the form auto-save or submits it; an ST then opens that submission in the normal downtime processing UI.
+- **Observable consequence:** The response bag retains `equipment_1_tweak: 'true'`, but `renderPlayerResponses` builds each equipment row from only catalogue id/name, quantity, and notes. The only repository references to the new response key are the player-form write/render/slot-shift sites, so the ST sees an ordinary equipment request and has no indication that the player requested a +1 stat tweak. The feature's own player copy says the ST will adjudicate it, but the ST-facing surface drops the signal.
+- **Confidence:** High. The complete equipment renderer was inspected and a repository-wide source search found no downstream reader of `equipment_${n}_tweak`.
+
+## Medium
+
+### [Pass 2] Dual-shaped combat gear is supported by the catalogue editor but has only a weapon tweak path
+
+- **Severity:** Medium
+- **File:line:** `public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js:390`; `public/js/admin/equipment-catalogue-admin.js:32`
+- **Triggering input or sequence:** An ST creates or edits `combat_gear` with both a weapon field and an armour field populated—for example, `damage_mod: 1` and `armour_value: 2`—then a player selects it in an equipment-acquisition row.
+- **Observable consequence:** The admin module explicitly says both subsets may be populated “in principle,” renders all five weapon/armour inputs together, and performs no mutual-exclusivity validation. Nevertheless, `equipmentTweakableField` returns `damage_mod` at the first predicate and never offers an armour-value tweak. A supported catalogue row therefore loses one of its two plausible tweak choices by branch order alone.
+- **Confidence:** High. Direct execution returned `damage_mod` for the dual-shaped fixture, and both the schema and admin form permit that fixture.
+
+### [Pass 2] A checked request still migrates when the catalogue selection changes
+
+- **Severity:** Medium
+- **File:line:** `public/js/tabs/downtime-form.js:2785`; `public/js/tabs/downtime-form.js:5613`
+- **Triggering input or sequence:** In one row, select tweakable item A, check its tweak checkbox, then choose different tweakable item B from the same `dt-equip-cat` select.
+- **Observable consequence:** At change time the select already contains B while the old checked checkbox is still present. `collectResponses()` therefore pairs B's id with `'true'`, and `renderForm()` immediately renders B checked. The code comment claims the re-render tracks the current item “not a stale one,” but the request itself is stale and silently changes target.
+- **Confidence:** High. The full collection loop and delegated change branch establish the event-order/data pairing; the saved state is keyed only by slot, not catalogue id.
+
+### [Pass 2] Stat-less `skill_gear` rows are valid but still receive a bonus-dice tweak UI
+
+- **Severity:** Medium
+- **File:line:** `public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js:395`; `server/schemas/equipment_catalogue.schema.js:47`; `public/js/admin/equipment-catalogue-admin.js:287`
+- **Triggering input or sequence:** Create `skill_gear` with its optional `bonus_dice` input blank, or load an existing/legacy row with `bonus_dice: null`, then select it in the downtime form.
+- **Observable consequence:** The schema requires only `bucket` and `name`; the admin input is optional and serializes blank as `null`. `equipmentTweakableField` checks only the bucket, returns `bonus_dice`, and renders a request to add 1 to a numeric field the item does not have. This contradicts the helper's “has a tweakable numeric bonus” contract.
+- **Confidence:** High. The valid input shape is confirmed by the schema/admin code, and direct execution returned `bonus_dice` for `{ bucket: 'skill_gear' }`.
+
+## Low
+
+### [Pass 2] Unit coverage omits both catalogue shapes that expose the helper defects
+
+- **Severity:** Low
+- **File:line:** `server/tests/issue-879-defence-penalty-wirein.test.js:615`
+- **Triggering input or sequence:** Regress either ambiguous-combat handling or the assumption that every `skill_gear` row has `bonus_dice` while retaining the currently tested weapon-only, armour-only, neither-combat, and populated-skill fixtures.
+- **Observable consequence:** The suite remains green because it has no combat fixture with both shape subsets and no skill fixture with missing/null `bonus_dice`. The helper defects remain unguarded even though both shapes are valid under the real catalogue schema/editor.
+- **Confidence:** High.
+
+### Pass 2 checks that produced no finding
+
+- `tweakedAvailability` and `rawMax` use raw availability units on both sides. For non-negative catalogue availability, `raw + 1 > cap + fixer` is exactly equivalent to `max(0, raw + 1 - fixer) > cap`; direct fixtures with and without Fixer produced identical warning decisions.
+- Removing row 2 of 3 correctly copies row 3's tweak value into slot 2 inside the same loop as the other keys, then deletes the old last-slot key.
+- An empty row's stored `equipment_${n}_tweak: 'false'` does not make it count as used: `dt-action-summary.js` checks only catalogue id or legacy name, and `dt-completeness.js` does not inspect equipment keys.
+- `dt-equip-cat` occurs on exactly the rendered catalogue select and the delegated matcher; none of the later change-handler matchers also match that select, so the early return does not suppress another applicable branch.
+- A deleted/unloaded catalogue id degrades to `getCatalogueEntry(...) === null`, leaving `tweakField` null and rendering no checkbox without dereferencing the missing entry.
+- Real availability is integer-or-null by schema and the admin coerces it to a number. The new unit fixture field names match the catalogue shape; omitting `_id` does not affect either pure helper.
+- The split import is justified: issue #896 asserts the original import's brace contents exactly, while the new separate import contains both new names and both are used.

The player-facing data is stored yet indistinguishable from a normal acquisition in the adjudication surface, so the stated user outcome is absent.
+- **Confidence:** High. This is a literal Story mismatch backed by the complete downstream renderer and repository-wide source search.
+
+## Medium
+
+### [Pass 3a] Changing items violates AC #3's “unchecked by default” requirement
+
+- **Severity:** Medium
+- **File:line:** `specs/stories/feature.1155.eqc4-purchase-stat-tweak.story.md:73`; `public/js/tabs/downtime-form.js:2785`
+- **Triggering input or sequence:** Select tweakable item A, check its request, then switch the same row to different tweakable item B.
+- **Observable consequence:** B's newly rendered checkbox is checked because collection preserves the slot-level `'true'` value. AC #3 says the checkbox is unchecked by default, and AC #4 says the dependent UI must track the currently selected item rather than stale state; this sequence carries A's explicit choice into B without a fresh choice.
+- **Confidence:** High.
+
+### [Pass 3a] AC #5's warning is shown before the player checks the tweak request
+
+- **Severity:** Medium
+- **File:line:** `specs/stories/feature.1155.eqc4-purchase-stat-tweak.story.md:81`; `public/js/tabs/downtime-form.js:5613`
+- **Triggering input or sequence:** A character selects a tweakable item whose +1 cost is over the affordability threshold and leaves the newly rendered checkbox unchecked.
+- **Observable consequence:** AC #5 scopes the warning to “When the tweak checkbox is checked,” but `warning` depends only on `tweakCost > rawMax`; `tweakChecked` affects only the checkbox attribute. The row warns immediately for a request the player has not made. Checking/unchecking also schedules a save without re-rendering, so warning visibility cannot track checked state at runtime.
+- **Confidence:** High.
+
+## Low
+
+### [Pass 3a] `tweakedAvailability` narrows AC #2's nullish-default formula to integers
+
+- **Severity:** Low
+- **File:line:** `specs/stories/feature.1155.eqc4-purchase-stat-tweak.story.md:70`; `public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js:409`
+- **Triggering input or sequence:** A shared-module caller passes a tweakable partial with a non-nullish, non-integer availability, such as `{ bucket: 'skill_gear', availability: 2.5 }` or a numeric string from an uncoerced form.
+- **Observable consequence:** AC #2 literally specifies `(entry.availability ?? 0) + 1`; the implementation instead replaces every non-integer with 0 and returns 1. Current persisted catalogue documents are integer-or-null, so the normal DT path is unaffected, but the exported shared helper does not implement its stated input formula for partial/future callers.
+- **Confidence:** High on the literal discrepancy; Low-to-Medium on runtime impact because the current catalogue schema/admin path supplies integer-or-null.

+### Pass 3a checks that produced no finding
+
+- AC #5's comparison is not a units bug for valid catalogue data. Although the code compares raw tweaked cost with `rawMax = availabilityCap + fixerReduction`, that inequality is decision-equivalent to comparing Fixer-adjusted tweaked cost with `availabilityCap`; the warning fires at the same boundary.
+- AC #1 explicitly says every `skill_gear` entry returns `bonus_dice`, so Pass 2's stat-less-skill concern is a robustness/domain-contract concern, not a deviation from AC #1. The earlier frozen finding remains unchanged as required.
+- AC #1 does not define precedence for a combat entry satisfying both shape predicates, so it does not resolve the dual-shaped ambiguity found in Passes 1/2.
+- The implementation adds no character-equipment schema field, automated grant, downward or stacked tweak, or tweak surface for `tool_utility`/`narrative`/`container`; it also leaves the existing dropdown filtering loop unchanged.

+- **Severity:** High
+- **File:line:** `public/js/admin/downtime-views.js:1647`

+### [Pass 2] Dual-shaped combat gear is supported by the catalogue editor but has only a weapon tweak path
+
+- **Severity:** Medium
+- **File:line:** `public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js:390`; `public/js/admin/equipment-catalogue-admin.js:32`
+- **Triggering input or sequence:** An ST creates or edits `combat_gear` with both a weapon field and an armour field populated—for example, `damage_mod: 1` and `armour_value: 2`—then a player selects it in an equipment-acquisition row.

Nevertheless, `equipmentTweakableField` returns `damage_mod` at the first predicate and never offers an armour-value tweak. A supported catalogue row therefore loses one of its two plausible tweak choices by branch order alone.

+### [Pass 2] A checked request still migrates when the catalogue selection changes
+
+- **Severity:** Medium
+- **File:line:** `public/js/tabs/downtime-form.js:2785`; `public/js/tabs/downtime-form.js:5613`
+- **Triggering input or sequence:** In one row, select tweakable item A, check its tweak checkbox, then choose different tweakable item B from the same `dt-equip-cat` select.
+- **Observable consequence:** At change time the select already contains B while the old checked checkbox is still present. `collectResponses()` therefore pairs B's id with `'true'`, and `renderForm()` immediately renders B checked. The code comment claims the re-render tracks the current item “not a stale one,” but the request itself is stale and silently changes target.
+- **Confidence:** High. The full collection loop and delegated change branch establish the event-order/data pairing; the saved state is keyed only by slot, not catalogue id.

+### [Pass 2] Stat-less `skill_gear` rows are valid but still receive a bonus-dice tweak UI

+- **Severity:** Medium

+- **Triggering input or sequence:** Create `skill_gear` with its optional `bonus_dice` input blank, or load an existing/legacy row with `bonus_dice: null`, then select it in the downtime form.

This contradicts the helper's “has a tweakable numeric bonus” contract.

+- Real availability is integer-or-null by schema and the admin coerces it to a number. The new unit fixture field names match the catalogue shape; omitting `_id` does not affect either pure helper.
+- The split import is justified: issue #896 asserts the original import's brace contents exactly, while the new separate import contains both new names and both are used.

AC #3 says the checkbox is unchecked by default, and AC #4 says the dependent UI must track the currently selected item rather than stale state; this sequence carries A's explicit choice into B without a fresh choice.
+- **Confidence:** High.
+
+### [Pass 3a] AC #5's warning is shown before the player checks the tweak request
+
+- **Severity:** Medium
+- **File:line:** `specs/stories/feature.1155.eqc4-purchase-stat-tweak.story.md:81`; `public/js/tabs/downtime-form.js:5613`
+- **Triggering input or sequence:** A character selects a tweakable item whose +1 cost is over the affordability threshold and leaves the newly rendered checkbox unchecked.
+- **Observable consequence:** AC #5 scopes the warning to “When the tweak checkbox is checked,” but `warning` depends only on `tweakCost > rawMax`; `tweakChecked` affects only the checkbox attribute. The row warns immediately for a request the player has not made. Checking/unchecking also schedules a save without re-rendering, so warning visibility cannot track checked state at runtime.
+- **Confidence:** High.
+
+## Low
+
+### [Pass 3a] `tweakedAvailability` narrows AC #2's nullish-default formula to integers
+
+- **Severity:** Low
+- **File:line:** `specs/stories/feature.1155.eqc4-purchase-stat-tweak.story.md:70`; `public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js:409`
+- **Triggering input or sequence:** A shared-module caller passes a tweakable partial with a non-nullish, non-integer availability, such as `{ bucket: 'skill_gear', availability: 2.5 }` or a numeric string from an uncoerced form.
+- **Observable consequence:** AC #2 literally specifies `(entry.availability ?? 0) + 1`; the implementation instead replaces every non-integer with 0 and returns 1. Current persisted catalogue documents are integer-or-null, so the normal DT path is unaffected, but the exported shared helper does not implement its stated input formula for partial/future callers.
+- **Confidence:** High on the literal discrepancy; Low-to-Medium on runtime impact because the current catalogue schema/admin path supplies integer-or-null.
+
+### Pass 3a checks that produced no finding
+
+- AC #5's comparison is not a units bug for valid catalogue data. Although the code compares raw tweaked cost with `rawMax = availabilityCap + fixerReduction`, that inequality is decision-equivalent to comparing Fixer-adjusted tweaked cost with `availabilityCap`; the warning fires at the same boundary.
+- AC #1 explicitly says every `skill_gear` entry returns `bonus_dice`, so Pass 2's stat-less-skill concern is a robustness/domain-contract concern, not a deviation from AC #1. The earlier frozen finding remains unchanged as required.
+- AC #1 does not define precedence for a combat entry satisfying both shape predicates, so it does not resolve the dual-shaped ambiguity found in Passes 1/2.
+- The implementation adds no character-equipment schema field, automated grant, downward or stacked tweak, or tweak surface for `tool_utility`/`narrative`/`container`; it also leaves the existing dropdown filtering loop unchanged.
+- `git diff --name-status 41dd40ef -- .` listed only the two TM Suite source files and two tests from the supplied diff. No tracked TM Wiki, TM Cockpit, or TM Herald path is touched; sibling worktrees were not accessed.

+### [Pass 2] The captured tweak request is invisible in the ST processing UI
+
+- **Severity:** High
+- **File:line:** `public/js/admin/downtime-views.js:1647`
+- **Triggering input or sequence:** A player selects a tweakable catalogue item, checks `equipment_1_tweak`, and lets the form auto-save or submits it; an ST then opens that submission in the normal downtime processing UI.
+- **Observable consequence:** The response bag retains `equipment_1_tweak: 'true'`, but `renderPlayerResponses` builds each equipment row from only catalogue id/name, quantity, and notes. The only repository references to the new response key are the player-form write/render/slot-shift sites, so the ST sees an ordinary equipment request and has no indication that the player requested a +1 stat tweak. The feature's own player copy says the ST will adjudicate it, but the ST-facing surface drops the signal.
+- **Confidence:** High. The complete equipment renderer was inspected and a repository-wide source search found no downstream reader of `equipment_${n}_tweak`.

+## Medium
+
+### [Pass 2] Dual-shaped combat gear is supported by the catalogue editor but has only a weapon tweak path
+

+- **File:line:** `public/js/data/equipment-derivation.js:390`; `public/js/admin/equipment-catalogue-admin.js:32`
+- **Triggering input or sequence:** An ST creates or edits `combat_gear` with both a weapon field and an armour field populated—for example, `damage_mod: 1` and `armour_value: 2`—then a player selects it in an equipment-acquisition row.
+- **Observable consequence:** The admin module explicitly says both subsets may be populated “in principle,” renders all five weapon/armour inputs together, and performs no mutual-exclusivity validation. Nevertheless, `equipmentTweakableField` returns `damage_mod` at the first predicate and never offers an armour-value tweak. A supported catalogue row therefore loses one of its two plausible tweak choices by branch order alone.
+- **Confidence:** High. Direct execution returned `damage_mod` for the dual-shaped fixture, and both the schema and admin form permit that fixture.
+
+### [Pass 2] A checked request still migrates when the catalogue selection changes
+
+- **Severity:** Medium
+- **File:line:** `public/js/tabs/downtime-form.js:2785`; `public/js/tabs/downtime-form.js:5613`
+- **Triggering input or sequence:** In one row, select tweakable item A, check its tweak checkbox, then choose different tweakable item B from the same `dt-equip-cat` select.
+- **Observable consequence:** At change time the select already contains B while the old checked checkbox is still present. `collectResponses()` therefore pairs B's id with `'true'`, and `renderForm()` immediately renders B checked. The code comment claims the re-render tracks the current item “not a stale one,” but the request itself is stale and silently changes target.
+- **Confidence:** High. The full collection loop and delegated change branch establish the event-order/data pairing; the saved state is keyed only by slot, not catalogue id.

+- **Triggering input or sequence:** Create `skill_gear` with its optional `bonus_dice` input blank, or load an existing/legacy row with `bonus_dice: null`, then select it in the downtime form.
+- **Observable consequence:** The schema requires only `bucket` and `name`; the admin input is optional and serializes blank as `null`. `equipmentTweakableField` checks only the bucket, returns `bonus_dice`, and renders a request to add 1 to a numeric field the item does not have. This contradicts the helper's “has a tweakable numeric bonus” contract.
